title: Learning Multimodal Representations from Partially Paired, Small-Scale Data
abstract: arXiv:2611.30601v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Modeling multimodal data from partially paired samples is critical for advancing domains like biomedicine, where vast unimodal datasets and foundation models exist but paired data remains scarce. Existing fusion methods rely on large-scale paired datasets, limiting their use in scenarios with incomplete pairing. We introduce CAMEO, an adversarial learning-based modality fusion framework that integrates modalities from small, partially paired datasets. Combining any pre-trained unimodal encoder with a cross-modal latent alignment mechanism, CAMEO learns shared representations requiring only minimal paired samples. Evaluated on computational pathology tasks such as niche classification and cell type composition prediction, CAMEO achieves superior data efficiency, outperforming contrastive approaches like CLIP in low paired-data regimes, and highlighting the benefits of adversarial alignment when paired annotations are scarce. translated_title: 从部分配对的小规模数据中学习多模态表示
translated_abstract: 从部分配对样本中建模多模态数据对于推进生物医学等领域至关重要，因为这些领域虽然拥有大量单模态数据集和基础模型，但配对数据仍然稀缺。现有的融合方法依赖于大规模配对数据集，限制了它们在不完全配对场景中的应用。我们提出了CAMEO，一种基于对抗学习的模态融合框架，能够整合来自小型部分配对数据集的模态信息。CAMEO将任意预训练的单模态编码器与跨模态潜在对齐机制相结合，只需极少量的配对样本即可学习共享表示。在计算病理学任务（如微环境生态位分类和细胞类型组成预测）上的评估表明，CAMEO展现出卓越的数据效率，在低配对数据场景下超越了CLIP等对比学习方法，凸显了在配对标注稀缺时对抗对齐方法的优势。
tldr: 该论文提出CAMEO对抗学习融合框架，将预训练单模态编码器与跨模态潜在对齐机制结合，仅需极少配对样本即可从部分配对的小规模数据中学习多模态共享表示，在计算病理学任务上以卓越数据效率超越CLIP等对比方法。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes CAMEO, an adversarial learning-based fusion framework that combines pre-trained unimodal encoders with cross-modal latent alignment to learn shared multimodal representations from small, partially paired data, achieving superior data efficiency over contrastive methods like CLIP on computational pathology tasks.
